description: This file defines a WPF UserControl class 'DocumentPreview' for rendering and previewing MigraDoc documents within a Windows application. It includes methods for setting documents, navigating pages, and rendering pages to a visual document.

classes.name: DocumentPreview
classes.description: A WPF UserControl for previewing MigraDoc documents, supporting page navigation and rendering.

classes.name: DrawingVisualPresenter
classes.description: A helper class to render a single DrawingVisual within WPF visual tree.

methods.name: SetDdl
methods.description: Sets a DDL string or file, prepares the document, and renders pages.

methods.name: SetDocument
methods.description: Sets a MigraDoc Document for preview and prepares renderer.

methods.name: ClearDocument
methods.description: Clears the current document and renderer.

methods.name: GetSizeOfPage
methods.description: Retrieves size information for a specific page.
